**Verdict: hold it. The discount and its deadline need confirming before this goes out.**

**Claims check**

| Claim | Status |
|---|---|
| "the Christmas blend is back" | OK (new arrivals are fine as written) |
| "Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove" | OK (product facts) |
| "It's back in the shop" | OK, but repeats the first sentence |
| "30% off" | **Unsupported.** Not on the allowlist, and no source in this chat. |
| "Today only... ends at midnight" | **Unsupported, fake urgency.** Nothing confirms the offer is real, time-limited, and ends at midnight. |

**Problems**
1. **"30% off"**: this is a number claim, and I can't verify it. If the promotion exists, confirm the discount, what it applies to (the Christmas blend or the whole shop), and any code needed.
2. **"Today only" and "ends at midnight"**: this is scarcity language that must be real and verifiable. If the sale really ends tonight, keep it and confirm the exact end time and timezone. If not, cut it.
3. **Minor, not blocking:** "the Christmas blend is back" and "It's back in the shop" say the same thing, so keep the sharper one.

**Compliant version (if the offer is not confirmed)**

> Quick one this week: the Christmas blend is back in the shop. Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove.

**If you confirm the offer is real and ends tonight**

> Quick one this week: the Christmas blend is back in the shop. Black tea, orange peel, cinnamon and a little clove. [PROOF NEEDED: confirm 30% off scope, code if any, and end time] 30% off until midnight tonight.
